durable_submit_p99_ms.verdict: NOT-DECIDABLE from client wall (upper bound p99 91.7 ms incl. CLI spawn; corrected 78.1 ms). Mean submit-minus-ping ~36 ms suggests real durable-commit cost well above trivial; server-side instrumented lane required.

attached_output_p99_ms.verdict: PROXY EXCEEDS at p99 (109.5 ms) under 100-job burst; p50 17.2 ms. Delivery lag grows under load -> risk signal for the attached-output lane; needs instrumented attach-path measurement.

psi_nvml_reaction_p99_ms.verdict: PROBE-ONLY: lower layers have huge headroom (NVML query p99 0.062 ms; PSI 3-file read p99 0.242 ms). End-to-end reaction needs a sanctioned pressure/fault drill; none exists (only preemption-drill.kpi-schema.json, no runner).

live_cgroup_restart_adoption_s.verdict: SKIPPED per constraint: measurement requires restarting the live delegated-cgroup daemon and no sanctioned drill script exists. Existing evidence is in-process only (v8.0.0 release receipt durable_restart 127.9 ms, diagnostic lane, not target-host).

incidental_findings.detail: NVML v1 used=476,839,936 B with 0 compute processes on idle RTX 3090 trips refresh_gpu_availability() unaccounted_usage -> healthy=false -> GPU jobs never admitted. Same v1 accounting on xbabe1 (504,496,128 B) means the 4090 will clamp on its first GPU-demand pass. See e2-typed-allocation-xbabe3-20260716.json blocker_found.

1 of 100 burst jobs (01KXNFR0FDFFJXBZMMB1XDNYB7) was auto-paused mid-burst and left with no adopted cgroup; scq resume fails permanently with 'Conflict: paused job has no adopted cgroup'; only cancel clears it. Pause/exit race under opportunistic backpressure -> wedged job. 99/100 completed clean.
